newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 50 mln kuna 42-day T-bills, rate down.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 50 mln kuna 42-day T-bills, rate down.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 50 million kuna through 42-day treasury bills.
The issue was priced at 98.750 kuna with an interest rate of 11 percent, down from 13 percent two weeks ago.
Bids equalled the offer, at 7.5-14 percent. The weighted average was 10.96 percent.
The bills are payable on November 28 and mature on January 9.
The ministry will next auction 65 million kuna worth of 42-day T-bills on December 10. The auctions are not open to foreign investors. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-41-450893
